title: JmapClient missing Debug impl
description: JmapClient has #[derive(Clone)] but no Debug impl. Any wrapper type that #[derive(Debug)] while holding a JmapClient will fail to compile. reqwest::Client implements Debug (redacting internals); url::Url implements Debug; Arc<dyn AuthProvider> could delegate to the auth provider's Debug. A manual impl that redacts the auth field (similar to BearerAuth's existing Debug impl) would allow downstream #[derive(Debug)].
